facts: The Beijing model catalog exposes the exact model ID qwen3.8-max.
Qwen3.8-Max accepts visual input and returns text.
qwen3.8-max is an undated provider alias; this artifact does not claim a frozen snapshot.
The Qwen3.8-Max series supports structured output.
The selected Chat Completions contract uses response_format type json_schema with strict true.
max_completion_tokens limits chain-of-thought plus answer output.
The documented actual total output may exceed max_completion_tokens by up to 10 tokens.
Thinking can be enabled with enable_thinking and bounded with thinking_budget; reasoning_effort and thinking_budget are not sent together.
Beijing list pricing is CNY 12 per million input tokens and CNY 36 per million output tokens for input requests up to 1,000,000 tokens.
Reasoning and answer tokens are billed at the output-token rate.
No discount, free quota, cache discount, or batch discount is assumed.
